name: Enthusiast Review
tagline: Independent PC hardware reviews and buying guides
llmsIntro: Independent PC hardware buying guides: graphics cards, CPUs, CPU coolers, power supplies, cases, RAM, motherboards and SSDs. Every part has a spec sheet, a research-based ER Score (0–100) and a verdict. Parts are researched against spec sheets, platform documentation, independent measurements and owner reports; they were not bench-tested by us.
